queue.name: Dorra (Durra) Gas Field Export Pipeline (Saudi share)
queue.note: Cross-Neutral-Zone Dorra/Arash shared-field gas export line landing at Al-Khafji; Package 2B (export pipelines) still pre-award. No roster match (P5854 Wafra onshore, P2702 Khafji crude are different).

evidence.note: KJO awarded offshore Package 1 (7 jackets + intra-field lines) to Larsen & Toubro on 2025-10-28. States Package 2B (central gathering platform) covers 'pipelines for gas and condensate transmission to each shareholder', i.e. a transmission line to the Saudi (Khafji) side; Package 2B not yet awarded.
Contractors submitted bids for the ~$10bn Dorra offshore gas development (3 offshore + 1 onshore EPC packages); Package 2B = central gathering platform complex plus export pipelines and cables.

Dorra offshore field (Neutral Zone) targeting ~1 bcf/d gas shared equally by Saudi Arabia and Kuwait, each piped separately to its own territory; Saudi gas lands at the Khafji onshore processing plant (up to 632 mmcf/d).
Background on the Khafji/Neutral-Zone joint development operated by KJO (AGOC + KGOC) landing hydrocarbons in Saudi Khafji.

queue.name: Midyan Gas Plant–Duba Sales Gas Pipeline
queue.note: NW Red Sea sales-gas line Midyan plant->Duba power station, operating ~2017, ~84-98 km. No NW/Red Sea gas row exists in the SA roster (all Eastern Province/East-West). Sales-gas line only (parallel condensate line out of scope).

evidence.note: Midyan plant (production started 2017) processes 75 MMscf/d; project includes construction of two 98 km pipelines to deliver sales gas and hydrocarbon liquids to the ~570 MW power station near Duba (Green Duba Initiative), replacing diesel firing.

Two ~84 km parallel pipelines carry processed condensates and gas from Midyan to a bulk plant near the Saudi Electricity Company power plant at al-Muwaylih near Duba; construction 86% complete Oct 2016, completion Dec 2016.
Aramco building Midyan gas plant in NW Saudi Arabia to supply gas to the Duba power station, its first gas project in the northwestern region.

queue.name: Jafurah Gas Plant Export Pipeline (Package 5)
queue.note: ~349 km Jafurah Gas Plant sales-gas export line into national grid; distinct EPC package from MGS III (P5885 / P6717-P6737). Jafurah Phase 1 onstream Dec 2025 -> likely operating. Vet whether it should fold into P5885 network.

evidence.note: Jafurah Gas Plant Package 5 gas pipelines project; EPC covers installation of a 349 km-long pipeline to export gas from the Jafurah gas plant. Verifier confirms '349' token present on page.
Project DB entry: Saudi Aramco, Jafurah Gas Field Development Phase 1, Package 5 Export Pipelines, gas sector, status listed 'Completed'. Plant processes up to 1.1 Bcf/d raw gas producing sales gas.
Nesma & Partners / SICIM JV EPC contract awards for Jafurah Phase II and MGS Phase III (July 2024), covering gas compression facilities and associated export pipelines.
